name: Suzuki GS500E
engine: 487 cc air/oil-cooled DOHC parallel twin, two carbs
intro: A tough, common learner bike. Most problems come from varnished carbs and old wiring.

G: Check the carb slide diaphragms for cracks while the carbs are apart. Cracked diaphragms cause flat spots.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Carbs
known.what: Varnished jets cause poor idle, hesitation and hard starting.
